=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_chatgpt_pool_token.py:481-511 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The last run's comment says `.github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json` ships in Phase 2, but the present-file branch of `test_config_contract` still asserts `set(data) == {"schema_version", "broker_url", "audience", "reviewer_slot_enabled"}` (line 502) and pins broker_url and audience (lines 503-509); the plan's Phase 2 file (docs/plans/chatgpt-account-reviewer-trial-plan.md:342-344) has the keys `reviewer_slot_enabled`/`model`/`replaces`/`reasoning`, so the two branches check contracts that cannot both hold.
  WHY: When the plan-shaped file lands, the "ChatGPT pool token action tests" CI step fails at line 502, and if the test is loosened, scripts/chatgpt_pool_token.sh (lines 129-134) reads an empty `broker_url` and finishes `broker_not_configured`, which leaves the action permanently unavailable; all three reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- tests/test_chatgpt_pool_token.py:481-500 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The last run's `if not CONFIG.exists(): ... return` branch passes the test when the required `.github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json` is absent, with no `pytest.xfail`/`pytest.fail` marker or skip reason.
  WHY: CI goes green while the action's default config path always yields `available=false reason=config_missing` (scripts/chatgpt_pool_token.sh line 131; default path at line 60), which hides an issue #8970 requirement-3 gap instead of fixing it; both reviewers rated this MAJOR.
- tests/test_chatgpt_pool_token.py:485 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `test_config_contract` fails because the required config file `.github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json` is missing.
  WHY: The CI check "ChatGPT pool token action tests" fails during execution because the required configuration file is not on the filesystem (reported as BLOCKER).
- .github/actions/chatgpt-pool-token/action.yml:inputs.config_path | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The config_path description "Empty uses the copy shipped with this action." is false because no copy ships (Glob of .github/ai/* returns only claude_engine.json).
  WHY: Any caller that relies on the default config path always gets available=false reason=config_missing (scripts/chatgpt_pool_token.sh line 131), and the docs describe a kill-switch file that does not exist (reported as NIT).
- changelog.d/chatgpt-pool-token.md:2 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The fragment says "`reviewer_slot_enabled` is `false` in `.github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json`", but the file is absent from the ref.
  WHY: At release, `scripts/assemble_changelog.py` folds the false claim into CHANGELOG.md, so operators see a committed kill switch that does not exist; there is no runtime failure (reported as NIT; sonnet cites the same line inside its action.yml finding).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
